consumer: A caller who already selected a claims file and one instrument reference, and needs to check that reference's Git-object custody. This is not a historical-round auditor or a claim-admission authority.

request_members.claims_file: Exact lane-relative .ufo/waves/round-N/claims.json path; not a discovered cohort
request_members.freeze: Full lowercase40hex first-add commit of claims_file in measured history
request_members.reference: One literal reference, not a shell command
request_members.sha256: Full lowercase64hex hash of instrument blob at freeze
request_members.supersessions: Array of unique full commit identities with lowercase64hex sha256 and nonblank string reason; all must change this instrument after freeze and at/before measured

normalization.rule: At most one supported leading prefix is stripped. The result is an ASCII lane-relative path with at least two nonempty components, no dot/parent components, no whitespace, backslash, colon or shell metacharacters; allowed components use letters/digits/underscore/dot/hyphen; no component begins with a dash. Suffix py/sh/js/mjs/ts is matched case-insensitively. Any lane-relative root including scripts is supported, not only a regex root allowlist.
normalization.bare_names: reference_unresolved, exit2; never guess by basename even when unique
normalization.unsupported: reference_unsupported, exit2; never evidence of no instrument or clean absence
normalization.absolute_paths: Unsupported in this finite consumer API; caller supplies a lane-relative reference explicitly, never silently rebases an external path

git_checks: Read one repository top and explicit immutable commit objects; neutralize inherited Git routing/replacement configuration; never run audited source
First-add claims identity must exactly equal declared freeze, freeze must be ancestor of measured; ambiguous/readded/nonlinear unsupported claims history is unevaluable, not guessed
Enumerate exact freeze tree entry before reading blob. Missing regular path is instrument_absent1; nonregular or unreadable Git object is unevaluable2
Instrument must exist with the same blob and regular mode in the unique freeze parent; otherwise instrument_not_prior1
Frozen blob SHA256 must match request sha256; otherwise pin_mismatch1
Enumerate all post-freeze commits that change the exact instrument path; a missing disclosure is revision_undisclosed1
Each supersession must name a real commit in that exact path-change set, and its digest must match the blob at that commit; forged or wrong-path entries cannot be silently ignored
expected_json: An object with finding:string, scope:explicit_reference_custody_only, and useful object identities/digests or error metadata. Ruler grades only exact process exit and primary finding across every frozen case and retains whole stdout/stderr.
not_claimed: R24 original calibration claim repaired or admitted
discovery of all instruments in arbitrary prose/shell
authenticity of Git authors/committer time or SHA provenance
proof of which historical instrument actually executed
live target, ELF metadata held item, packet secret bodies, USB/devices/chains or remote execution
prerequisite_order: Main-authorized exception: independent cases+contract+executable ruler land before claims; claim freezes their digests; candidate auditor under test is implemented only after actual claims landing. Candidate is not mislabelled as a preexisting ruler. Any compatibility finding from old R24 gate reading new R25 claims is disclosed separately, never repaired by modifying old gate/ledger.
baseline_count_interpretation: Missing candidate is unavailable. Ruler records every case not_observed, executed0, matched0; do not claim34 experimentally observed old failures. The substantive before counterexamples are source-derived and outside R24's unchanged original failure record.
